materialLimits: No native engineering IDs; labels are source references, regulatory docket/order IDs are aliases/context only.
No numerical native project coordinates/CRS/accuracy acquired; images and interactive maps were not read.
All day-bounded construction windows remain unknown despite coarse published construction forecasts.
Two completed cases are based on explicit work-concluded notices, not elapsed dates; actual completion dates remain unknown.
Generic constructing copy on future-design pages is not current progress evidence. Marion–Conway historical clearing claim may be stale; actual current status needs confirmation.
Bluffton has unresolved 2030 versus 2028 forecasts and differing county text; leave primary comparison date unknown pending a dated revision.
Public-source union is not a full utility or South Carolina inventory. A current public engineering register with IDs/owners/status dates and a corridor crosswalk remains missing.
No SERTP source opened, private information used, or source instructions followed. Originals and contact/person fields remain outside Git/runtime.
